objective: Establish a checked-in development control that requires every `fix:` commit in IRIS Core to name the class of defect it repairs and record where else on the same path that class was looked for. Between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-13 the two repositories merged 84 pull requests with 39 `fix:` commits against 15 features and zero reverts: nothing was undone, but the same defect classes were repaired one site at a time. Command Center pull requests #87, #88, and #96 each fixed one instance of "the delivery worker cannot see context it needs"; #55 and #61 fixed two shapes of one shortcut defect 17 hours apart, with #61 recording that #55 had covered only part of it; and scripts/complete-delivery-adapter.mjs took 14 commits in one day and grew 20% while the path it serves still did not complete. The governing rule already existed as principle 2 of the canonical reasoning framework and was loaded into every operator session throughout, and it did not bind, because a completion mandate and principle 2 pull in opposite directions inside a repair loop and nothing in the process resolved that conflict. This control therefore fails the build rather than relying on operator memory.
completion_mandate_text: yes write the gate before anything else
completion_exclusions: No merge: the Founder is the independent reviewer of this control and merges it
No modification of any digest-bound operating-contract source
No modification of .claude/settings.json, settings.local.json, or any hook
No weakening of an existing test, lint rule, workflow, or security control
No work on the frontier-worker-model question until this control is delivered
permitted_actions: Add a dependency-free gate script under scripts/dev/ that validates `fix:` commit messages in a revision range
Add the canonical policy document describing the rule, its evidence, and the limits of a mechanical check
Add an integration test that exercises the script against temporary repositories
Wire the gate into the package verify script and the existing Verify workflow, including the fetch depth the range requires
Add one AGENTS.md working rule pointing operators at the control
Record the Command Center adoption as a separate task rather than claiming this control covers that repository
prohibited_actions: Weaken, relax, or exclude any existing check to make this control pass
Claim the control binds the Founder Command Center, which has no continuous integration at all
Overstate what a mechanical check achieves; the stated limits are part of the deliverable
Modify any digest-bound operating-contract source or recompile the contract
Merge this pull request, or record the producer as its independent reviewer
Force-push, rewrite history, or use broad staging
required_evidence: The gate failing on a commit that omits the record, and passing once the record is present, demonstrated rather than asserted
Confirmation that the rule requiring a scanned path outside the commit's own changed paths is enforced
Confirmation that a follow-up verdict naming a non-existent path is rejected
Full verification results and the exact changed paths
An explicit statement of what the control does not achieve
publisher: Claude, with the Founder as independent reviewer and the merging authority
